diagnostic.title: Week 0 diagnostic
diagnostic.rules: No AI, no Googling. 60–90 minutes. Mark each problem solved, partly solved or stuck, and note what stopped you.
diagnostic.reading: If 1–3 and 6 come easily, you can move faster. Getting stuck on 2, 3 or 7 is normal and shows where to begin.
